---
title: "F1 Results Web Scraping"
format: html
---

```{r}
# Import packages
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r}
# Function to retrieve race URLs from seasonal results pages
scrape_seasons <- function(urls) {
  
  map_df(urls, function(url) {
    
    page <- read_html(url)
    rows <- page %>% html_elements("table tbody tr")
    
    map_df(rows, function(row) {
      
      race_node <- row %>% html_element("td:first-child a")
      
      tibble(
        race_link = race_node %>% html_attr("href")
      )
    })
  }) %>%
    mutate(full_link = paste0("https://www.formula1.com", race_link)) %>%
    pull(full_link)
}
```

```{r}
# Function to retrieve race result data
scrape_races <- function(urls) {
  
  race_name <- urls %>%
    str_split("/") %>%
    unlist() %>%
    .[length(.) - 1] %>%
    str_to_title()
  
  year <- urls %>%
    str_split("/") %>%
    unlist() %>%
    .[6]
  
  page <- read_html(urls)
  
  df <- page %>%
    html_node("table") %>%
    html_table() %>%
    select(Driver, Laps) %>%
    mutate(
      Driver = Driver %>%
        str_replace_all("\u00A0", " ") %>%
        str_squish() %>%
        str_remove("\\s*[A-Z]{3}$") %>%
        stringi::stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") %>%
        str_squish(),
      
      Race = race_name,
      Year = year
    )
  
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}
# Run web scraping function on all race results (1989-present)
all_races <- map_dfr(race_result_urls, scrape_races)
```

```{r}
# Confirm unique driver names
all_drivers <- as.data.frame(unique(all_races$Driver))
```

```{r}
# Create `laps_completed.csv` and `race_starts.csv`
laps_by_year <- all_races %>%
  group_by(Driver, Year) %>%
  summarise(Laps_Completed = sum(Laps, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(laps_by_year, "Data_Files/laps_completed.csv", row.names = FALSE)

starts_by_year <- all_races %>%
  group_by(Driver, Year) %>%
  summarise(Race_Starts = n(), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(starts_by_year, "Data_Files/race_starts.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
